notes.text: Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist best known for developing the known theory of relativity.
Albert Einstein also made important contributions to quantum theory.
Albert Einstein received the 1921 Nobel Prize in Physics for "his services to theoretical physics, and especially for his discovery of the law of the photoelectric effect".
Albert Einstein is remembered as a scientist connected with Germany, Switzerland, United States.
Albert Einstein's recorded life dates place this profile around 1879-1955.
